content.user_title: Build Azure AI Search Apps with Python
content.value_statement: Azure AI Search projects need correct SDK patterns for indexes, queries, vectors, and enrichment. This skill gives practical Python examples for building and operating search workflows.
actual_capabilities: Shows how to install and import the Azure Search Documents Python package.
Provides examples for API key and DefaultAzureCredential authentication.
Demonstrates index creation with vector fields and HNSW configuration.
Covers keyword, vector, hybrid, semantic, filter, facet, suggest, and autocomplete queries.
Includes patterns for document upload, merge, delete, batching, indexers, and skillsets.
Shows async client usage and common Azure SDK error handling.
limitations: Requires an existing Azure AI Search service and valid project configuration.
Does not provision Azure resources or manage billing settings.
Example schemas and vector dimensions must be adapted to the target embedding model.
Security, access control, and production testing remain the user responsibility.

use_cases.title: Create a Search Index
use_cases.description: Define fields, vector profiles, semantic configuration, and idempotent index creation in Python.

use_cases.title: Add Retrieval to an AI App
use_cases.description: Combine vector queries, keyword search, filters, and semantic ranking for retrieval workflows.

use_cases.title: Maintain Search Data Pipelines
use_cases.description: Use upload, merge, delete, batching, indexers, skillsets, and error handling patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Search Client
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for an existing service.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Azure Search Documents Python SDK to create a SearchClient for my existing index. Prefer DefaultAzureCredential and explain which environment values I need.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Vector Index
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft Python code for an Azure AI Search index with id, title, content, and embedding fields. Include HNSW vector search settings and notes for matching embedding dimensions.

prompt_templates.title: Design Hybrid Retrieval
prompt_templates.scenario: Combine keyword, vector, and semantic ranking.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Python search pattern that runs hybrid retrieval with a VectorizedQuery, keyword text, selected fields, filters, top results, and semantic ranking.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an Enrichment Pipeline
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced indexing with skillsets and operations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an Azure AI Search Python workflow for batch document ingestion, indexer setup, skillset enrichment, retry-aware uploads, and error handling for production use.

output_examples.input: I need to query an Azure AI Search index with text and embeddings.
output_examples.output: A hybrid retrieval plan that explains the client setup, vector query construction, selected fields, filters, result limits, and semantic ranking options.

output_examples.input: I need a new index for documents with embeddings.
output_examples.output: A Python-oriented index design with key fields, searchable text fields, an embedding field, vector profile settings, and semantic configuration guidance.

output_examples.input: I need safer production authentication for search clients.
output_examples.output: A recommendation to use DefaultAzureCredential, define required environment settings, avoid production API keys where possible, and validate permissions before deployment.

best_practices: Prefer DefaultAzureCredential for production authentication when supported by the deployment.
Match vector dimensions to the embedding model before creating or updating indexes.
Use batching and retry-aware clients for large document ingestion workloads.
anti_patterns: Do not hard-code real service keys or endpoints in generated application code.
Do not mix vector dimensions from different embedding models in one field.
Do not deploy example schemas without adapting fields, filters, permissions, and ranking settings.

faq.question: Does this skill create Azure resources for me?
faq.answer: No. It provides Python SDK guidance for Azure AI Search workflows. You must provide the service, permissions, and configuration.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is structured as guidance for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it support vector search?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes vector field setup, HNSW configuration, vector queries, and hybrid search examples.

faq.question: Does it recommend API keys?
faq.answer: It shows API key examples, but it also marks DefaultAzureCredential as the preferred production approach.

faq.question: Can it help with semantic ranking?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers semantic query type, semantic configuration, captions, and combined hybrid retrieval patterns.

faq.question: What should I validate before production use?
faq.answer: Validate credentials, index schema, vector dimensions, data access controls, retry behavior, monitoring, and cost impact.
